audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the Bath House pool confession, Pam’s upgraded-house prayer, Abigail’s mine confession, Marlon’s mine introduction, and the mine rescue text. All dialogue, embedded questions, response choices, gender branches, and character voice were reviewed in event context. Canonical Yoba, Joja, Pierre, Mines, Marlon and Adventurer’s Guild terminology was applied. Event commands, relationship deltas, response IDs, actors, movement, timings, conditions, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotes, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. One command-only event-state record is explicitly preserved. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
